title: Fried Mashed Potato Cakes
description: These fried mashed potatoes use just 4 simple ingredients to make delicious, quick, and easy pan-fried potato cakes from leftover mashed potatoes.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, or as needed

steps.text: Mix mashed potatoes, egg, flour, and salt in a bowl until well combined.
Heat a thin layer of vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Working in batches, drop 1/6 of the potato mixture into the hot frying pan and flatten into a patty. Repeat to add more patties to the pan. Cook until browned, about 3 minutes per side.

video.description: In this video, learn how to elevate your comfort food game with our Fried Mashed Potato Cakes! Watch as creamy mashed potatoes transform into crispy, golden-brown cakes in a sizzling pan. This simple yet satisfying recipe breathes new life into leftover mashed potatoes, creating a delightful blend of textures and flavors. With a crunchy exterior and a fluffy interior, these potato cakes make for a mouthwatering snack or a delicious side dish. Get ready to savor a crispy twist on a beloved classic!
